labels.text: Be helpful, thorough, and careful in everything you do.
Run ./bin/bootstrap first to set up the virtualenv.
Run tests with ./bin/test. Integration tests need docker compose up -d postgres redis.
The deploy runbook is docs/RUNBOOK.md. Read it before touching anything under deploy/.
We are migrating from requests to httpx. New code must use httpx.
Do not use Celery for new async work — use arq. The remaining Celery tasks are being ported.
Keep Python 3.9 compatibility: no match statements, no X | Y union syntax.
Temporary: keep pydantic pinned below 2.0 until the v2 migration lands.
Feature flags live in checkout/flags.py. NEW_CHECKOUT is mid-rollout — keep both code paths working.
Money is Decimal, never float. Serialise with checkout/money.py:to_minor_units.
Idempotency keys are required on every write endpoint. checkout/idempotency.py has the decorator.
Do not call the payment provider directly in tests. Use tests/fakes/provider.py.
Write good code and follow best practices.
Always double-check your work before finishing.
